character.name: King
character.description: Gains one gold for each yellow (noble) district in their city. They receive the crown token and will be the first to choose characters on the next round.

placedCards.name: University
placedCards.description: This district costs 6 gold to build, but is worth 8 points at the end of the game

placedCards.name: Fortress
placedCards.description: A normal card with no ability

placedCards.name: Haunted City
placedCards.description: For the purposes of victory points, the Haunted City is considered to be of the color of your choice.  You cannot use this ability if you built it during the last round of the game

cards.name: Docks
cards.description: A normal card with no ability

cards.name: School Of Magic
cards.description: For the purposes of income, the School Of Magic is considered to be the color of your choice.  If you are the King this round, for example, the School is considered to be a noble (yellow) district.

cards.name: Imperial Treasury
cards.description: At the end of the game, you score one point for each gold in your possesion.  Gold placed on your district cards do not count towards this total

cards.name: Observatory
cards.description: If you choose to draw cards when you take an action, you draw 3 cards, keep one of your choice, and put the other 2 on the bottom of the deck
